what: Duplicates the image into 11 layers (10 horizontal strips + 1) and tears it in one of three types — ① stacked as strips, only the one strip pointed to by cos(frame×−.12) stretches up to 50x vertically (sin(frame×.2)) and pushes the lower strips away, and with spin the whole plate rotates frame×2° ② the 11 layers are stacked and scaled 1–2x from the center (sin(frame×5°+layer×30°)) while brightness oscillates 0–100% ③ the 11 layers are each offset by 360/11° and rotated ±360° with the hue rotated by the same angle. At intensity 0 the original image stays as is, and the effect blends in by intensity. Redraws every N frames (every) on a 60fps frame basis and switches type with a 1% chance each frame

options.types: Type numbers to use (0, 1, 2) separated by commas, default 0,1,2. Original hero logos 0,1,2 · list photos use just 0 or 1
options.every: How many frames between redraws (at 60fps), default 3. Original hero 2 · list photos 5
options.spin: 1 means the whole panel rotates by the intensity in a ① shape (original hero logo)
options.lines: Number of band lines, default 10 (layers are lines+1)
options.swap: Probability (%) of changing type per frame, default 1. 0 locks the first chosen type
options.rate: Intensity. Default chaos (--fx-chaos, 1 if absent) · top (chaos × the amount the top 25vh is lowered) · number (fixed)

note: Intensity reads --fx-chaos, which scroll-chaos-mode writes to the style of html (when both parts are used together, tearing only begins after scrolling back and forth over 1500px). Without that part, rate: 1 always tears. The image is data-fx-part="pic"(first img·svg·canvas if none) and the original image is hidden while it only holds the space

from.where: index.html .kk-fv__logo (hero logo — types 0,1,2 · every 2 · spin) · .kk-item__pic (list photo — 0 or 1 · every 5)
